body.heading: All aboard
paragraphs: Line up chairs in a row. The first chair is for the driver, who makes the best train noises.
Hand everyone a ticket. Tickets must be checked before the train can leave.

body.heading: The journey
paragraphs: Call out what you pass: mountains, the sea, a field of cows, a tunnel. Everyone looks out of the same side.
When you arrive, announce the station grandly. Travellers must take their imaginary luggage.

takeaway: A row of chairs can travel further than any real train.
safetyNotes: An adult helps line up the chairs so they are steady to sit on.
screenFreeExtension: Draw the view from your train window at the most exciting part of the trip.
